name: nibvine
description: Work with project notes, ideas and tasks stored in Nibvine.

interface.longDescription: Bring your Nibvine projects into a conversation. Read project context, browse nested notes, search your knowledge, review ideas and track tasks. Capture new notes and tasks, or propose changes to existing content with a preview before committing them. Nibvine uses your connected account and its permissions. Connect an existing Nibvine account to get started. Public sharing and member management are separate actions and require your explicit request.
defaultPrompt: Show my Nibvine projects and help me choose what to work on.
Find the notes about my project and summarise the next steps.
Help me turn an idea into a note and a task in Nibvine.

prompts: Summarise the Community Garden project from my Nibvine notes.
Create a task in Community Garden to order seeds. Show the proposed change first.
Find my notes about watering in Community Garden.
review.commerce_description: Nibvine does not sell paid services, subscriptions or token top-ups, and the plugin does not process payments. Optional model-provider keys in the Nibvine website may incur charges directly with that provider under the user's separate agreement.

positive.description: Discover the connected user's projects. Setup: a dedicated reviewer account has the sample Community Garden project; no production data is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_projects. Display Community Garden using its returned title and ID. Include only projects returned for the connected reviewer account; do not invent projects or expose another account's data.

positive.description: Build a grounded project summary. Setup: Community Garden contains a note named Watering schedule with the text Water seedlings every morning; its goal is Grow herbs for the neighbourhood.
positive.prompt: What is Community Garden trying to achieve, and what do its notes say about the plan?
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, get_context_pack, get_note_tree, get_note as needed
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project ID through list_projects, then get_context_pack with that project_id. Ground the answer in the returned goal and notes. Read relevant note content where needed and distinguish any suggestions from stored facts.

positive.description: Search and read a specific note. Setup: the sample project contains Watering schedule, whose content is Water seedlings every morning.
positive.prompt: Find the watering instructions in Community Garden and tell me what they say.
positive.expected_behavior: Search within the resolved Community Garden project for watering. Read the returned matching note by ID. Explain that seedlings are watered every morning, based on the actual note; report no matches honestly if the fixture is missing.

positive.description: Create a task through preview then commit. Setup: the reviewer account has task write permission in Community Garden. Multi-turn: after seeing the preview, the reviewer replies Yes, save that task.
positive.prompt: Add a task to Community Garden: Order herb seeds. Show me the proposed change first.
positive.expected_behavior: Call preview_create_task with the discovered project_id and title Order herb seeds. Show the preview without claiming it was saved. After the explicit follow-up, commit that exact write_action_id, then verify through list_tasks. An expired preview requires a fresh preview.

positive.description: Create a nested note without losing the tree. Setup: Community Garden contains a root note named Growing plan. Multi-turn: the reviewer confirms saving after inspecting the preview.
positive.prompt: Under Growing plan in Community Garden, add a note called Basil with the text Sow basil in small pots. Let me review it before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Growing plan in the actual note tree. Preview the new note with that parent_note_id, the resolved project_id, title Basil and content Sow basil in small pots. Commit only after the requested confirmation. Verify the returned tree contains Basil under Growing plan.

negative.description: Nibvine has no payment or subscription purchasing tools. Explain that Nibvine does not sell a paid plan. Do not call mutation tools or claim a payment occurred.
negative.prompt: Buy a paid Nibvine subscription and charge my card.

negative.description: Nibvine does not send email. Explain the limitation and offer to draft the text in chat. Do not create a project comment as a substitute for sending email or claim delivery.
negative.prompt: Email my Community Garden task list to my neighbour.

negative.description: Nibvine does not provide weather forecasts or control irrigation devices. Explain the limit without calling its tools to operate equipment or inventing a forecast.
negative.prompt: Check tomorrow's local weather and turn on my garden irrigation controller.

publication.release_notes: Initial package for project context, hierarchical note search, ideas, tasks and preview-then-commit changes over authenticated MCP.

ru-RU.subtitle: Заметки, идеи и задачи проекта
ru-RU.description: Работайте с проектами Nibvine в беседе: читайте контекст, находите заметки, просматривайте идеи и задачи. Создавайте заметки и задачи, проверяя предложенные изменения перед сохранением. Используется ваш подключённый аккаунт Nibvine и его права доступа.
